data.title: 神裂火织 · 暮色天台上的晚风牵手
data.description: 高耸大厦天台边缘晚风猎猎，如瀑黑发马尾在漫天霞光中肆意飞扬。神裂火织侧身站立，十指与你紧扣，收起所有圣人的凌厉，眼神中流淌着毫无保留的信赖与温柔。
data.location: high-rise skyscraper rooftop terrace overlooking panoramic city sunset
data.action: standing by rooftop railing at dusk, black ponytail dancing in wind, interlocking fingers with partner, looking at him with gentle loving violet eyes
data.lighting: magnificent golden hour sunset bathing skyline and silhouettes in crimson gold
data.mood: heroic cinematic romance, unshakeable trust, breathtaking sunset tranquility
data.promptProse: Standing on a windy high-rise rooftop at golden sunset, Kaori Kanzaki holds hands with partner, black ponytail dancing in wind with a tender loving smile.
data.animaCaption: Kaori Kanzaki holding hands lovingly on windy sunset rooftop.
